source_notes: Keep the fall log on a BMS trip. (1) APPROVED (Atlas): logger on its own thread with a ring buffer, fsync every 100 ms, never fsync in the 50 Hz loop. (3) PROPOSED, conditional: 2x Maxwell BCAP0010P270S01 in series (Maxwell datasheet: 10 F, ESRdc max 30 mOhm, 3.1 g, 10 x 30.5 mm) = 5 F, ~60 mOhm; charger/backup = ADI LTC3226 (16-QFN 3x3).
